name: Bead PSF stack
description: Macro: a fine Z-stack around the current focus, for a measured PSF. Focus on a sparse slide of beads smaller than the resolution (100 to 200 nm), set light and exposure in the capture step so the brightest bead is not saturated, then run it. Z moves half the range up and down: check the objective's clearance first. Step: a third of the axial FWHM or less; range: about six times it (the Deconvolve panel's PSF view shows the FWHM). Then open the stack in the OME-Zarr viewer, Deconvolve, PSF model Measured, Distill from this image.
